sloka: पूर्वम् क्षत्र वधम् कृत्वा गत मन्युः गत ज्वरः ।क्षत्रस्य उत्सादनम् भूयो न खलु अस्य चिकीर्षितम् ॥१-७४-२२॥
transliteration: pūrvam kṣatra vadham kṛtvā gata manyuḥ gata jvaraḥ ।kṣatrasya utsādanam bhūyo na khalu asya cikīrṣitam ॥1-74-22॥

translations.english: Enraged at the slaughter of his father (by Kartaveeryarjuna), is he intent upon exterminating the kshatriya race? Having slaughtered the kshatriyas, in the past he was freed from anger and grief. Is he again desirous of annihilating the kshatriyas?
